title: Domain Registrations Autopay Loyalty Credit: Questions on Lapsed-Year Renewals
content:
## Autopay loyalty credit — basis questions answered

**The rule.** For a grace-period renewal of Domain Registrations billed on or after 1 December 2025, the lapsed-year autopay credit, one of the lapsed-year credits of that renewal, is USD 0.50 for each renewed year where the domain's auto-renew setting is on and no declined auto-renew attempt is recorded on it less than 12 whole months before the day of the renewal, USD 0.20 for each renewed year where the setting is on and at least one such declined attempt is recorded, and nothing where auto-renew is off.

**Which setting counts?** The auto-renew setting the domain carries on the day of the renewal: on or off.

**Which declines count?** Declined auto-renew attempts recorded on this domain, each with its attempt date, where fewer than 12 whole months separate that date from the day of the renewal, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached. Declines recorded on other domains of the account do not count.

**Does the number of declines matter beyond one?** No. One declined attempt in the window and several declined attempts lead to the same figure.

| Auto-renew setting | Declined attempts on the domain in the window | Autopay credit |
|---|---|---|
| On | none | USD 0.50 for each renewed year |
| On | one or more | USD 0.20 for each renewed year |
| Off | any | nothing |

**Hypothetical dates.** A declined attempt recorded on 3 February 2027 is inside the window for a renewal on 2 February 2028 (11 whole months) and outside it for a renewal on 3 February 2028 (12 whole months).
